label: Roborock S8 robot vacuum with LiDAR maps
description: Roborock S8 is a 6000 Pa robot vacuum and sonic mop with PreciSense LiDAR navigation, multi-floor map storage and Reactive 3D obstacle avoidance. It is Wi-Fi only and 2.4 GHz only - Roborock does not support 5 GHz on its robots - with no Ethernet port, so the vacuum and its dock only ever exist on the wireless side of a lab.
